DTF printing Colorado Springs — no minimums. Need just 1 shirt? ARK does Direct to Film printing in-house. Small orders, fast turnaround, full color.

DTF Printing in Colorado Springs

Most print shops won't touch a small order — the setup cost makes it impractical. At ARK, we use DTF printing for small orders, which means no minimums, no setup fees, and no compromises on quality.

DTF stands for Direct to Film. Your design is printed onto a special transfer film, then heat-pressed directly onto the garment. The result is a vibrant, full-color print with crisp detail that holds up wash after wash — and it works on just about any fabric.

Whether you need one custom shirt for a birthday, five jerseys for a small team, or a quick sample before placing a larger order, ARK has you covered in Colorado Springs.

No Minimum Order

Print as few as 1 shirt. No setup fees, no minimums.

Full Color Prints

Unlimited colors, gradients, and photographic designs.

Fast Turnaround

3–5 business days from artwork approval.

What Is DTF Printing?

Direct to Film printing is a heat-transfer process that works like this: your design is printed in full color onto a special PET film, coated with a hot-melt adhesive powder, and then heat-pressed onto your garment. The result is a smooth, flexible print that bonds directly with the fabric fibers.

Unlike traditional screen printing, DTF requires no screens and no color separation — which means there's no minimum order quantity to make it cost-effective. You get the same quality result whether you're printing 1 shirt or 50.

Unlike vinyl heat transfer, DTF handles complex artwork, gradients, and photographic images without any cutting or weeding. If your design can be printed, DTF can transfer it.

No Setup Fees

No screens, no color separation charges. Your price is the same whether it's your first shirt or your fifth.

Complex Designs Welcome

Gradients, shadows, photographs, fine detail — DTF handles it all without extra cost.

Durable & Wash-Resistant

DTF prints are flexible and durable. They won't crack, peel, or fade with normal washing.

DTF vs. Screen Printing: When We Use Each

At ARK, we use the right method for your order size so you always get the best value:

  • 1–23 shirts → DTF printing. No setup cost makes DTF the clear choice for small orders.
  • 24+ shirts → screen printing. At higher quantities, screen printing's per-shirt cost drops significantly and delivers exceptional durability.

You don't have to figure this out yourself — just tell us your quantity and we'll recommend the right method and give you a quote.

Want the full breakdown? Read our guide: DTF vs. Screen Printing — Which Is Right for Your Order?

What We Can Print On

DTF works on virtually any fabric type — cotton, polyester, blends, and even some performance fabrics. Both light and dark garments print beautifully.

  • T-shirts and long-sleeve shirts
  • Hoodies and crewneck sweatshirts
  • Tank tops
  • Tote bags and accessories
  • Most woven and knit fabrics

Not sure if your garment works with DTF? and we'll let you know.

Common Questions About DTF Printing

What is the minimum order for DTF printing?

There is no minimum. We print as few as 1 shirt. DTF is specifically designed to be cost-effective at any quantity.

How long does DTF printing take?

Standard turnaround is 3–5 business days from artwork approval. Rush services are available — contact us to discuss your timeline.

What file formats do you need?

We prefer vector files (AI, EPS, PDF) for best results, but we can work with high-resolution PNG or JPG files as well. When in doubt, send us what you have and we'll let you know.

Does ARK ship DTF orders?

Yes — we ship orders nationwide. Local pickup is also available in Colorado Springs.
